title: 은행 창구에서: 통장 하나 만들고 싶어요
objective: Ask to open a bank account and use -(으)ㄹ게요.
summary: A bank-counter dialogue on opening an account, with -(으)ㄹ게요.
setting: At a bank counter. A foreign resident wants to open a bank account and get a debit card.

task.title: Practice the bank counter talk
task.line: Read the dialogue first, then fill in, choose, order, or answer in Korean as each question asks.

words.meaning: bank account (the bankbook that goes with it)
words.exampleMeaning: I opened an account for my salary.

words.meaning: bank account (used mainly with 번호, number)
words.exampleMeaning: Please text me your account number.

words.example: 은행에 갈 때 신분증을 꼭 가져가세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Be sure to bring your ID when you go to the bank.
The forms are on that table over there.
I usually pay with my debit card.

words.meaning: PIN (secret number for a card or account)
words.exampleMeaning: I can't remember my card PIN.

dialogue.meaning: I'd like to open a bank account.
Do you have an ID card?
Yes, here is my residence card.

dialogue.korean: 잠깐 확인할게요. 이 신청서에 이름, 주소, 전화번호를 써 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: I'll check it for a moment. Please write your name, address, and phone number on this form.

dialogue.korean: 네, 지금 쓸게요. 체크카드도 같이 만들 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Okay, I'll write them now. Can I get a debit card too?

dialogue.korean: 그럼요. 같이 만들어 드릴게요. 비밀번호 네 자리를 여기에 눌러 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Of course. I'll make one for you. Please enter a four-digit PIN here.
Here are your bankbook and debit card.

exercises: Change the verb to the -(으)ㄹ게요 form. Use -ㄹ게요 after a vowel and -을게요 after a consonant: ① 서류를 (복사하다) ____. ② 사진을 (찍다) ____. ③ 내일 다시 (오다) ____. ④ 안내문을 먼저 (읽다) ____.
Choose the right word: ① 카드 ____는 다른 사람에게 말하지 마세요. (비밀번호 / 주소) ② 이 ____에 이름과 생년월일을 써 주세요. (신청서 / 체크카드) ③ 돈을 받을 ____ 번호를 알려 주세요. (계좌 / 자리)
Put the steps in the order they happen in the dialogue: (가) 비밀번호를 눌러요. (나) 신분증을 보여 줘요. (다) 통장을 받아요. (라) 신청서를 써요.
Read the dialogue and answer in Korean: 손님은 통장하고 무엇을 같이 만들었어요?
answers: ① 복사할게요 ② 찍을게요 ③ 올게요 ④ 읽을게요
① 비밀번호 ② 신청서 ③ 계좌
